original_idea.body:
# Mutation Testing the Monitor: Measuring Sabotage-Detection Coverage

**Problem:** We don't know how thorough a control monitor really is. There is no coverage metric for monitors.

**Direction:** Adapt mutation testing: generate a diverse zoo of sabotage mutants into benign trajectories, measure the monitor's mutation kill rate, and categorize surviving mutants to map blind spots. Run on open transcripts with a small monitor.

**Why it matters:** Provides an attack-class-stratified coverage score for monitors, exposing blind spots before deployment. Doable with API/consumer GPU only.

**Relevant context:** Meta's ACH (engineering.fb.com 2025; arXiv:2503.08182); Redwood AI Control 2023.
